judged_text: symmetricDecrypt is called with process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || "", and decrypting with an empty key string will throw (or return garbage that JSON.parse throws on), converting a misconfiguration into an unhandled 500. A self-hoster who sets CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET but forgets CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY gets a 500 with no diagnostic, instead of a 4xx/703-style config error identifying the missing variable.

adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`), decryption only happens after an early guard: `if (!APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED) return 403`. `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` (`packages/lib/constants.ts`), so if a self-hoster sets `CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET` but forgets `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY`, the handler returns a 403 and never calls `symmetricDecrypt(..., "" )`. Therefore the claimed unhandled 500 from decrypting with an empty key is not supported by the diff.
